# ADR-0011: Crucible-rendered deployments — generate the loop/broker/rig manifests from the manifest + a deploy profile

> **Status:** accepted | **Date:** 2026-06-28

**References:** [ADR-0002](../adr/ADR-0002.md), [ADR-0005](../adr/ADR-0005.md), [ADR-0008](../adr/ADR-0008.md), [ADR-0009](../adr/ADR-0009.md), [RFC-0001](../rfc/RFC-0001.md)

## Context

Loop pod specs (~250 lines YAML each) duplicate manifest values, require manual digest pinning, and are ~90% identical across domains. Three structural problems drove this decision: pod env duplicates the manifest (every manifest field change requires a matching YAML edit), manual digest pinning is error-prone (stale digests caused production incidents), and the pod spec is copy-pasted across domains with hand-maintained divergence.

## Decision

`crucible deploy render`/`apply` generates the loop pod + broker wiring + RBAC from two inputs: the domain manifest (already the source of truth) and a thin deploy profile (environment-specific facts like cluster endpoints and image overrides). The renderer projects manifest config into pod env, resolves and pins image digests at render time via oci-client, shares a template per backend, and emits RBAC references. Implemented as a native Rust renderer with real k8s-openapi types, including a kube-rs migration that removed the kubectl dependency from the engine.

## Consequences

Positive: one source of truth (manifest edit + re-render replaces yaml safari). Reproducible deploys with digests computed at render time, eliminating the stale-binary bug class. Composes cleanly with the controller. Lowers domain onboarding bar.

Negative: the renderer must track every manifest field the pod spec consumes, and a new field requires a renderer update. The deploy profile is a new artifact to maintain per environment.

## Alternatives Considered

### Native Rust renderer with k8s-openapi types, projecting manifest config into pod env with digest pinning at render time (accepted)


### Use kustomize or Helm templates to generate deployment YAML (rejected)
